title: loup-garou
description: Werewolf Plugin: an immersive game mode with secret roles and day/night cycles for strategic games between players.
body:
LoupGarou is a comprehensive Minecraft plugin that transforms your server into a true multiplayer experience inspired by the Werewolf game, with fully automated management of roles, phases, and special actions.

The plugin orchestrates a smooth and immersive game cycle (waiting, night, day, voting, end of game), complete with a dynamic scoreboard, custom messages, ambient sounds, and global announcements, to deliver a clear and engaging experience without manual intervention.

The role system automatically adapts to the number of connected players. As the game grows, new special roles are activated based on configurable thresholds.

In addition to the classic roles (Werewolf, Villager, Seer, Guard, Witch), the plugin includes advanced roles that enrich the gameplay:

Hunter: Eliminates a player upon dying
Elder: Withstands an initial attack
Cupid: Creates a couple with a life link
Little Girl: Discreetly observes the werewolves
Assassin: Strategically eliminates werewolves

Each role has unique mechanics, encouraging strategy, cooperation, and tension between players.

The commands have been designed to be simple, fast, and intuitive in-game:

/lg kill, /lg see, /lg protect, /lg heal, /lg poison, /lg revenge, /lg bind, /lg spy, /lg assassinate, as well as /vote for group decisions.

The plugin also offers comprehensive administration commands (/lg start, /lg stop, /lg reload, /lg status, etc.) with integrated auto-completion for immediate use.

The game status is continuously displayed on the scoreboard, including the number of players alive, dead, and remaining camps, ensuring optimal readability.

One of LoupGarou's strengths is its intelligent automatic start system:
As soon as the minimum number of players is reached, a countdown begins. If this threshold is no longer met, the game is automatically canceled.

This system is compatible with WorldGuard (optional), allowing you to limit the number of players to a specific area.

👉 Result: a robust, modern, and ready-to-use plugin, ideal for minigame servers, role-playing, or community events, offering dynamic gameplay with minimal configuration.
